Your first game

Your first game starts here.

A few simple details help the club find a suitable introduction to the court.

01

Choose a starting point.

Tell the team whether you are trying padel for the first time, returning to sport, or bringing experience from another racket game. Your starting point helps shape a suitable introduction.

02

Get the details.

Ask what equipment you need, what the session includes, and how the club confirms your place. Check practical details before arriving so you can focus on enjoying your first game.

03

Bring a friend—or ask.

Let the team know whether you already have playing partners. Ask about coaching or social sessions if you are coming on your own. Share your experience and the kind of game you are looking for.
